name: (05) Serpentis — 3 Advanced — The Heart of Darkness

system.description:
As the old Egyptian judges weighed the hearts of the dead against a feather, so you cheat that judgment as you cheated death itself — drawing your own withered heart from your unliving breast to hide it away.

On the night of the new moon you may remove your heart; no test is necessary, but the subject must be willing (doing it to another vampire takes several hours of out-of-play surgery). The coaxed-forth heart does not rot, and while it is out of your body you are immune to staking. As the seat of emotion, its removal grants a bonus Trait on Virtue Tests to resist frenzy, but costs you all Empathy Abilities and any warm Social Traits such as Friendly, Empathetic or Genial. If the separated heart is staked, you are immediately paralyzed; should it meet fire or sunlight — even a single health level's worth — it is destroyed and you erupt into flame, reduced to ash and Final Death in a single turn. The power can also return a stolen heart to its former body.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
